urdu transliteration:
Ali Ali Akbar, Ali Ali 
Shabih e Payambar Ali Ali, Aye janaam
english translation text:
Ali, Ali Akbar, Ali, Ali.
The likeness of the Prophet, Ali, Ali, O my beloved.

urdu transliteration:
Nazar utha key thou maa ko dekho ey beta, Aye janaam
Kyun sar jhukaye kharey huey ho ey beta, Aye janaam 
tum hi thou maadar ka asra ho ey beta
english translation text:
Raise your eyes and look at your mother, my son.
Why do you stand there with your head lowered, my son?
You are your mother's only support, my son.

urdu transliteration:
Aye Jaan e Maadar, Ali Ali 
Aye Jaan e Maadar, Ali Ali 
Shabih e Payambar Ali Ali 
Shabih e Payambar Ali Ali
english translation text:
O life of your mother, Ali, Ali.
O life of your mother, Ali, Ali.
The likeness of the Prophet, Ali, Ali.
The likeness of the Prophet, Ali, Ali.

urdu transliteration:
●Aye merey yousuf e jamal e Akbar ruk jao, Aye janaam
Na jee sakegi tumhari madar ruk jao, Aye janaam
Sahain gey kesey yeh daagh sarwar ruk jao
english translation text:
O my Yusuf of beauty, Akbar, stop for a moment, my beloved.
Your mother will not be able to live without you, my beloved.
How will the Master bear this wound of grief? Stay, my beloved.

urdu transliteration:
Ruko ey Safdar, Ali Ali 
Ruko ey Safdar, Ali Ali 
Shabih e Payambar Ali Ali 
Shabih e Payambar Ali Ali
english translation text:
Stay, O brave one, Ali, Ali.
Stay, O brave one, Ali, Ali.
The likeness of the Prophet, Ali, Ali.
The likeness of the Prophet, Ali, Ali.

urdu transliteration:
●Hai Umm e Laila key lab pey noha wawaila, Aye janaam
Lahoo mey dooba hai laal mera wawaila, Aye janaam
Hua hai seenay key paar neza wawaila
english translation text:
Upon the lips of Umm-e-Laila is the cry of lamentation, my beloved.
My son lies drenched in blood, my beloved.
A spear has pierced straight through his chest, my beloved.

urdu transliteration:
Fida ho Madar, Ali Ali 
Fida ho Madar, Ali Ali 
Shabih e Payambar Ali Ali
Shabih e Payambar Ali Ali
english translation text:
May your mother be sacrificed for you, Ali, Ali.
May your mother be sacrificed for you, Ali, Ali.
The likeness of the Prophet, Ali, Ali.
The likeness of the Prophet, Ali, Ali.

urdu transliteration:
●Nabi ki surat, Nabi ki seerat ey Akbar, Aye janaam
Nisaar tujh pey jahan ki azmat ey Akbar, Aye janaam
Pukarti hai tujhey shahadat ey Akbar
english translation text:
O Akbar, you bear the appearance of the Prophet and his character.
The greatness of the world is sacrificed for you, O Akbar.
Martyrdom itself is calling out to you, O Akbar.
